name: Mavericks
storyline: Thirty years have passed since the wiping out of all Mavericks and the Hunters are little more than peacekeepers. That changes when Zero disappears on an investigation and previously defeated Mavericks start popping up across the world. X must get his butt into gear, defeat the Mavericks and save the world...and maybe Zero while he's at it.
summary: A fan-made RPG based on the characters and storyline of the Megaman X series created by Capcom.
